opening.argument: The offer requires viewers to enter a branded Bitcoin trading pool with at least $100, while promising that they will be “compounding daily.” It presents referral participation as an income stream, including a 10 percent referral bonus, and ties a weekly binary bonus to personally introducing people into two positions while maintaining at least $200. The materials depict these bonuses as wallet funds available for withdrawal or reinvestment, alongside BTC transfer and pending-bonus workflows. These features establish a recruitment-linked investment return proposition. The available evidence does not establish that any transfer, trading activity, or payout was completed.

citations.quote: You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of Bitcoin.
The next stream of income from Mirotit Trading International is the referral bonus.
This will qualify you for the binary bonus and you will receive a weekly binary bonus for your smallest leg.
